name: 先天性緑内障

summary.text: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by an elevated intra-ocular pressure. The clinical presentation frequently associates an increase in the size of the eye, as well as corneal edema.

symptoms.text: increase in the size of the eye
symptoms.evidence: increase in the size of the eye
